name: Lin Wenqi
intro: Technical Art studies across Unity and Unreal Engine 5, from material response to early environment workflows.
about: Computer Science undergraduate focused on Technical Art across Unity and Unreal Engine 5, with an emphasis on how authored data, runtime logic and rendering produce readable visual behavior. Project Kinetica is a completed Unity material-response study; current development centers on Project Confluence, an early UE5 coastal district environment. The work combines district blockout with separate sandbox experiments in parameter-driven Blueprint construction, height-based material wetness and real-time rendering.

projects.name: Project Kinetica
projects.summary: A focused Technical Art study connecting weapon motion, impact evaluation, vertex deformation and material-specific particles.
